name: ref-silent-without-powerdown
displayName: REF - workstation was silent WITHOUT a sleep or shutdown, or its upload stalled
description: Per computer, evaluated when a machine reports again: a telemetry gap over 20 minutes with no sleep, hibernate or shutdown event at its start, or at least 10 heartbeats arriving over an hour late (upload stalled while awake). Replaces the real-time silence alerts, which cannot tell asleep from broken because power-down events reach the workspace only after wake (measured 9 Oct 2026). NIST 3.3.4, 3.14.6.
